name: manifest_coverage_reason
description: Why the SBOM tool could not resolve a dependency manifest. An unresolved manifest makes a package missing from the SBOM unknown, never absent.

definitions.no-lockfile: A manifest whose versions only a lockfile pins, with none beside it or above it in the tree.
definitions.unpinned: A manifest the tool reads directly that declares requirements without an exact version (a requirements file's ranges), which the tool drops.
